bibliographic.title: Large Language Models Hallucination: A Comprehensive Survey

relevance_to_mlgg: Comprehensive taxonomy of hallucination causes across the LLM lifecycle (data, architecture, inference). Provides structured framework for classifying hallucination types in MLGG extraction pipeline.
key_findings: Hallucination causes span entire LLM pipeline from data collection to inference
5 detection categories: retrieval, uncertainty, embedding, learning, self-consistency
Structured output constraints reduce but do not eliminate semantic hallucination
actionable_for_mlgg: Use taxonomy to classify types of hallucination in metadata extraction (factual vs fabrication)
Uncertainty-based detection applicable via token-level probabilities
Self-consistency (multiple extractions, majority vote) as verification strategy
